question: Does a fourth admitted job fit the 16 GiB build VM with a 10 GiB engine at three parallel operations and a 4 GiB runner slice?

production.window: 2026-09-26T00:10Z..16:40Z, after the 8 vCPU / 16 GiB resize; Prometheus job build-vm; 15 s samples joined with GitHub job timelines
production.reading: Engine working set is mostly retained page cache: 5.4 GiB with no job running; anonymous memory across the whole VM stayed below 3.5 GiB

local_engine.engine: registry.dagger.io/engine:v0.21.9 with --cpus=8 --memory=10g --memory-swap=10g --pids-limit=3072 --oci-max-parallelism=3 --oci-worker-gc and the production GC policy
local_engine.clients: infra pipeline image --check-only; GO_BUILD_PARALLELISM=3 and GO_BUILD_MEMORY_LIMIT=1137MiB derived from the engine as in production

jobs.backend: llunde-backend Containerfile (Gradle, JDK 25) with its check-reports target

local_engine.host: Linux amd64, 16 CPUs, 30 GiB; a separate k3d cluster ran on the host during all scenarios
local_engine.four_heavy_jobs: runner-check twice with distinct GO_BUILD_PARALLELISM (2 and 3), so both compile every Go tool, plus runner-rust and backend
local_engine.cache: Every scenario ran on an empty engine cache: fresh volumes, and a forced engine removal between runs discarded the retained cache

queue_replay.model: Image-build jobs labelled dagger-amd64, 2026-09-19..2026-09-26T16:40Z, replayed at their created times and observed durations; a job starts when its repository has a free runner (infra 3, Y 2, portfolio 2, others 1), admission has a free slot and no job of the same repository and name runs

conclusion: Four admitted jobs fit: engine anonymous and kernel memory peaks at 2.5-2.9 GiB with three cold jobs and 3.0-4.1 GiB with four, of 10 GiB, parallelism 3 bounding concurrent operations; four concurrent cold scans use 0.7 GiB anonymous of the 4 GiB runner slice; no OOM kill in any scenario; build times unchanged; retained page cache fills the engine limit with three or four jobs and is reclaimed, as in production

local_runner_side.method: Four concurrent production scanner-analysis commands (trivy 0.74.0, --scanners vuln --severity HIGH,CRITICAL, cold analysis cache, shared vulnerability and Java databases) in one systemd scope with MemoryMax=4G, over OCI archives of the four images
